title: Notice to members: financial statements sent without an annual general meeting
summary: Tells the members the financial statements were sent and no annual general meeting is held, and how a member may still require one.

fields.name: sent_on
fields.label: The day the statements were sent to the members

paragraphs: The financial statements of {{.Company.Name}} for the financial year ended {{.F.fy_end}} were sent to the members on {{.F.sent_on}}.

Under section 175A of the Companies Act 1967, a private company that sends its financial statements to its members within 5 months after the end of its financial year need not hold an annual general meeting.
A member may still require the company to hold an annual general meeting by notice to the company within 14 days after the financial statements were sent.
